'''Warvog Arkon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He led the [[Havoc Squadron]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. Warvog resided on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], in [[Nym's Stronghold]]. This shows that he had ties to [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]].
